Learned counsel for the claimant submitted that an order of pay and recovery can be made.
The benefit of pay and recovery is only applicable to the claimants who are third parties.

Those, persons who are covered as per Section 147 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, (for short, hereinafter referred to as 'the M.V. Act') are only entitled benefit of order of pay and recovery by virtue of Sub- Section (1) of Section 147 of M.V. Act, which is only to the third parties.
As per Section 147 of M.V. Act, there is compulsory coverage of insurance to third parties and also other persons enumerated therein.
But in the present case, the claimants being travelled in 407 Tempo neither third parties nor covered compulsorily under Section 147 of M.V. Act.
Therefore, an order of pay and recovery cannot be made.
Therefore, respondent No.5 who is owner of Tempo alone is liable to pay compensation.
